cluster_areas: cluster a list of 3D areas so that intersecting cubes are merged into unified regions
discrete_step_dir: compute a discretized unit vector in the direction of the agent's current yaw angle
fill_idmeta: add block id_meta information to a list of XYZ coordinates using the agent's block data
get_locs_from_entity: extract coordinate tuples from a mob, memory object, or list of coordinates
strip_idmeta: return a list of XYZ positions and drop the id_meta data from block objects
